name: MahaLend
summary: Aave-fork empty-market donation inflated index plus rounding error to over-withdraw
notes: The proxy selected the vulnerable Pool implementation in its constructor and emitted no later Upgraded event before the exploit.

The exploit receipt records exactly 10,001.466755107579871763 ARTH leaving the market token for the attack contract and then the beneficiary. It is valued at CoinGecko's nearest pre-exploit observation.
CoinGecko's nearest pre-exploit ARTH/USD observation is 42 hours 43 minutes before the exploit because the historical series is sparse.
